summary.headline: Glykas Against Fate and Astrology
summary.text: Glykas argues against genesis and fate, citing Hezekiah’s burning of Solomon’s books, Paul’s Epistle to the Romans, the sacred canons, and the Fathers. The passage rejects astrological determinism while allowing limited prognostication from the motion and order of the stars, concluding that man is self-determined and not subject to natural necessity.
